text.text_excerpt: This is hands down my favorite French quarter bar. A friend introduced me to this place and their owner who is an incredibly nice fun guy to speak with and he proudly runs a great locals bar. The prices are perfect and the bartenders are all laid back. They have a juke box as well and small courtyard

The Upper Quarter is a safe place for locals to go in the touristy French Quarter and is cleaner than your typical New Orleans dive. It is small enough where everyone in the whole room just talks to one another, joining in each other's conversation and friendly banter. They have trivia on Wednesday nights starting at 7 and winners receive free drink tokens. They allow dogs in the bar and there is also a cute little patio in the back. Tons of NOLA art and memorabilia cover the walls. This place just gives me a happy, cozy feeling and the bartenders are incredibly nice.

This is the epitome of a great neighborhood bar. We had just moved to New Orleans and wandered in because it was so close to our apartment. Marie, one of the owners, made us welcome immediately. And the next time we popped in she remembered our names. The bartenders and patrons are friendly, the drinks are inexpensive, and there is no better place to watch a Saints game. We are so lucky to have this bar in our neighborhood.
